title: Clarify three-language reader-first documentation entry

sources.reason: English reader-first entry and current navigation structure.
Chinese reader-first entry and the sentence under review.
Japanese reader-first entry and semantic sibling alignment.
Canonical reader journey, language coverage policy, and P0/P1/P2 rules.
Current documentation ownership and topic status registry.
Current capability status boundary used to prevent overclaiming.

rawUserRequest: 修正三个语言版本，WI全部流程完成为止。入口页面先解决项目理解，再引导到技术参考。P0 topic 仍为 planned 时，不能宣称完整的多语言覆盖。

declaredIntent.summary: Align the English, Chinese, and Japanese documentation entry pages around a reader-first understanding journey and an honest multilingual coverage caveat.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A non-technical reader can identify what AI Cockpit is, why it exists, and what remains human responsibility from each language entry page.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Each sibling page presents the same reader journey and links to the corresponding explanation pages.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review all three pages and run the documentation metadata, link, and capability claim checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A reader is not led to believe that planned or missing P0 language routes mean complete multilingual coverage.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The coverage caveat is understandable in all three languages and exact policy remains in the maintainer reference.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Cross-language semantic review against documentation-architecture.md and capability truth data.

riskAssessment.reason: Reader-facing navigation and wording changes only; no runtime or capability status changes.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The requested change is bounded to three documentation entry pages and their reader journey.

preReviewWarnings: Review that all three languages preserve the same North Star → purpose → design → architecture → capability boundary → human decision journey, while planned coverage is not overstated.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: All three docs/README language siblings lead with project understanding before technical reference navigation.
The three language siblings explain the same North Star, purpose, design philosophy, architecture/boundary, capability status, and human decision path without introducing unsupported claims.
The reader-facing coverage note explains that missing or planned P0 routes are migration work and does not use maintainer-only jargon as the primary explanation.
All links in the three entry pages resolve to existing repository paths, and the documentation metadata/capability checks pass.
guidelines: Keep the three language siblings semantically aligned; do not translate machine identifiers.
Do not elevate planned, template-only, adopter-installed, or externally-required capabilities to implemented status.

intent.problem: The three language documentation entry pages must help a non-technical reader understand the project before sending them into technical references. The current Chinese page contains a correct governance rule about planned P0 coverage, but it is written as maintainer metadata and the three language journeys are not clearly aligned around the project's North Star and boundaries.
constraints: Change only the three docs/README language siblings plus governed Work Item evidence.
Preserve the capability truth boundary: planned, template-only, adopter-installed, and externally-required status must not be presented as implemented.
Do not claim complete multilingual coverage while any required P0 route remains planned or missing.
Use language-appropriate reader wording; keep exact P0/P1/P2 policy in the maintainer reference.
intent.rationale: A reader-first entry should remove project-understanding friction before exposing technical references, while an explicit but understandable coverage caveat prevents the improved navigation from becoming an overclaim.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
